card.name: Word endings after "unders" or "under"
card.fires_on: The part of a word that follows "under" or "unders", such as "ides" in undersides, "ers" in underserved, or "urface" in undersurface. It also fires on "of" after underside.

modes.label: Underside words
modes.description: The ending of underside or undersurface, naming the bottom of an object or animal.
modes.example: Brown to pale gray above, with pure white unders<<ides>> and feet.

modes.label: Underserved
modes.description: The ending of "underserved" in headlines about communities or groups.
modes.example: Americans With Disabilities are Und<<ers>>erved by Online Technologies - 1

modes.description: The ending of a name or word starting with "Under", such as Underwood or underbelly.
